Public Function SplitPredictorSelfTest() As String
  Dim base() As Double, used As Boolean, before() As Double, i As Long
  On Error GoTo Failed
  lastDof = 1
  ReDim TDisp(1): ReDim UDisp(1): ReDim NodeCond(1): ReDim base(1)
  TDisp(0) = 3#: TDisp(1) = 99#: base(0) = 1#: base(1) = 2#
  P6MixedUP = False: P3HasJointElements = False: P3AfterCutback = False: AccelBaselineRetry = False
  AccelV1 = True: AccelV2a = True: AdaptiveEnabled = False
  AccelRememberIncrement base, 0.1, 6, 0
  before = TDisp
  P3ApplyIncrementPredictor 0.1, 1#, used
  If used Or Not AccelIncrementEligible Or AccelHistoryReady Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3751
  For i = 0 To lastDof
    If TDisp(i) <> before(i) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3752
  Next i
  SplitPredictorSelfTest = "PASS: V1 cannot consume stale history after a long increment"
  Exit Function
Failed:
  SplitPredictorSelfTest = "FAIL " & CStr(Err.Number) & " " & Err.Description
End Function
